title: Four new models for video, images and multimodal work
summary:
Four new models, dashboard-managed sandboxes, easier key grants and Quest rewards made for a crowded day in the garden.

Kandinsky 6.0 Lite adds five-second video with synchronized audio from text or a start image. Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo adds image generation and editing with up to ten references. Muse Wonder 1.0 and Gemini 4 Argon expand the text lineup with large context windows and multimodal input; Gemini also supports Google Search. The community app catalog gained Bit, an AI-agent narrator of short tech stories.

The Enter dashboard now has a page to create, manage and connect to sandboxes. Timeout handling moves to ten-minute paid-ahead leases, with a way to set a limit on a running sandbox. The large template gains more disk; both templates add rclone, cron, ffmpeg, uv and other everyday tools.

Model and sandbox permission refusals can now point to a focused page that grants access on an existing key without changing its other settings. Signed-in users can redeem one-off event codes for Quest Pollen, and Discord level 10 and 20 now have one-time Quest rewards. The Quest page and leaderboards received smaller fixes.

highlights.title: Kandinsky video with audio
highlights.text: Generate five-second 480p videos with synchronized audio from a prompt or start image using `kandinskylab/kandinsky-6.0-lite`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kandinskylab/kandinsky-6.0-lite).

highlights.title: Qwen image editing
highlights.text: Generate or edit images with `qwen/qwen-image-2.1-turbo`, using up to ten reference images. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen/qwen-image-2.1-turbo).

highlights.title: Gemini 4 Argon
highlights.text: Use `google/gemini-4-argon` with text, image, audio or video input, plus reasoning controls, tools and Google Search. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-4-argon).

highlights.title: Manage sandboxes in Enter
highlights.text: Create, pause, resume and connect to your sandboxes from the dashboard. Templates also gain tools including ffmpeg, uv and rclone. [Open the dashboard](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Bit tells tech stories
highlights.text: Watch short AI-agent-narrated stories about open-source projects and AI news in Italian and English. [Try it](https://bit.sessionweave.com).
